syph.definition: n a common venereal disease caused by the treponema pallidum spirochete; symptoms change through progressive stages; can be congenital (transmitted through the placenta)

sypher.translation: vt.(为构成齐平面)使部分重叠,使搭接,互搭( 木板的削边)

syphering.definition:
n. The lapping of chamfered edges of planks to make a
   smooth surface, as for a bulkhead.

syphilelcosis.translation: [医] 梅毒性溃疡形成, 梅毒性溃烂

n. Inoculation with the syphilitic virus, especially

syphon.definition:
n a tube running from the liquid in a vessel to a lower level outside the vessel so that atmospheric pressure forces the liquid through the tube
n a tubular organ in an aquatic animal (especially in mollusks) through which water can be taken in or expelled
v convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon
syphon.translation:
n. 虹吸, 虹吸管, 苏打水瓶, 虹管, 存水弯
vi. 通过虹吸管
vt. 用虹吸管吸出, 用虹吸管输送, 吮吸

syphon drainage.translation: [医] 虹吸导液法, 虹吸引流

syphonage.translation: 虹吸现象; 虹吸作用

syphoned.definition: v convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon

syphoning.definition: v convey, draw off, or empty by or as if by a siphon
